categories.main_business_segments: Sebang Global Battery primarily manufactures and sells automotive and industrial batteries, with key subsidiaries involved in non-ferrous metal smelting, automotive parts sales, lithium battery and related parts manufacturing, and battery accessory production. The company also engages in character merchandise manufacturing and licensing, content production and distribution, and plans to expand into e-commerce and telecommunication sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced battery manufacturing technologies including VRLA (Valve Regulated Lead Acid) and Ni-MH (Nickel-Metal Hydride) battery development. It holds patents related to battery manufacturing methods such as electrolyte leakage prevention, electrolyte mixing devices, and battery plate structures to enhance durability and safety. Production is carried out in multiple plants with high utilization rates, employing modern machinery and equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sebang Global Battery serves automotive manufacturers (OEMs), industrial users, and aftermarket service sectors. Its products are used in vehicles, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), telecommunications, solar hybrid systems, and electric vehicles. The company sells domestically through dealerships, direct sales, and institutional contracts, and exports globally to over 130 countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Changwon, Gwangju, and Ansan, and sales offices in Seoul and Anyang. It has overseas subsidiaries and exports extensively, with export sales accounting for 57.3% of total revenue, covering markets in Europe, North America, and other regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sebang Global Battery operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of batteries and related components. It also has upstream involvement through subsidiaries engaged in raw material processing (non-ferrous metal smelting) and downstream activities via automotive parts sales and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on R&D in advanced battery technologies such as Ni-MH and lithium batteries, battery module assembly for electric vehicles, and improving battery durability and safety. It invests in innovation to enhance product competitiveness and expand into new business areas like character licensing, content creation, and e-commerce. R&D expenditure is about 0.47% of sales, supporting continuous product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of automotive and industrial batteries, both domestically and internationally. Additional revenue streams include sales of battery-related products, character merchandise licensing, and content distribution. The company also engages in direct exports and local export partnerships, with sales conducted via dealerships, direct sales, and institutional contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sebang Global Battery is one of the top four battery manufacturers in South Korea, holding a 39.2% market share in 2023, making it the market leader. Major competitors include Hyundai Sungwoo Solite (11.5%), Korea & Company (23.7%), and Clarios Delco (17.5%). The industry is oligopolistic with the top four players controlling over 90% of the domestic market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Sebang Global Battery reported consolidated sales of approximately KRW 1.685 trillion, a 14.4% increase from the previous year, and an operating profit of KRW 129.9 billion, up 60.2%. The company has shown steady growth in production volume and sales over recent years, with assets totaling KRW 1.84 trillion and equity of KRW 1.34 trillion. The firm maintains a strong financial position with a low debt ratio of 37.2%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sebang Global Battery emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced batteries with patented features ensuring safety, durability, and performance. Its long-standing expertise since 1952 and global export footprint to over 130 countries position it as a trusted supplier. The company differentiates through continuous innovation, comprehensive product range for various applications, and expanding brand presence via character licensing and content marketing.
